name: Vendor shortlist
description: Who we might hire, what they quoted, and who's booked.

category.description: A kind of vendor we need exactly one of, like a venue or a photographer, with what we can spend on it.

budget.description: the most we want to spend on this category

vendor.description: A business we might hire, and where we are with them.

fills.description: the category this vendor would fill

add-category.title: Add a category
add-category.description: Start tracking a kind of vendor you need, optionally with a budget for it.

set-budget.title: Set the budget
set-budget.description: Set or change the most you want to spend on this category.

add-vendor.title: Add a vendor
add-vendor.description: Add a vendor you are considering, before you know which category they fill.

add-to-category.title: Add a vendor to this category
add-to-category.description: Add a vendor you are considering for this category, by name.

set-quote.title: Set the quote
set-quote.description: Record what a vendor quoted, in the app's currency.

mark-contacted.title: Mark as contacted
mark-contacted.refusal: {name} is already past the first conversation
mark-contacted.description: Note that you have reached out to this vendor.

book.title: Book
book.description: Mark a vendor as booked once you have committed to them.

decline.title: Decline
decline.description: Mark a vendor as declined; they drop out of view but are not deleted.

reopen.title: Reopen
reopen.description: Bring a declined vendor back into consideration.

file-under.title: File under a category
file-under.description: Say which category a vendor is for.

unfile.title: Take out of its category
unfile.description: Take a vendor out of the category they were filed under.
unfile.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a vendor out of this category

one-booked-per-category.title: One vendor booked per category
one-booked-per-category.description: Two booked photographers is a double payment waiting to happen.
one-booked-per-category.says: {name} has more than one vendor booked

booked-needs-quote.title: A booked vendor has a quote
booked-needs-quote.description: Committing without a number is how budgets drift.
booked-needs-quote.says: {name} is booked but has no quote

within-budget.title: Booked vendors fit the category's budget

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.
